Message:
A voice I did not know
echoed in my head.

Who said that...?
Could it be...
one of the Gods of Sand?

Right, Ayse said so, too.
We should not...have met...

Because, if she
had not met me...
Ayse would not have died!

Everything was a mistake.
Meeting Ayse,
wanting to learn...

Before I realized,
a storm of sand had begun
whipping around me.

It withered the plants,
and returned them to the land.

Life once withered
can never be returned.
If only...
my heart could shrivel, too...

Shrivel and crumble away...
along with my
memories with Ayse.
If everything withers away
into nothing, maybe then...
I could pretend we never met...?

If I could just erase
all those mistaken memories...
